# Casts from every type to every target.
top: k = 2;

template: int($0)
int => int -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
rat => int | #inexact -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f32 => int | #inexact | #invalid -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f64 => int | #inexact | #invalid -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f16 => int | #inexact | #invalid !! L1.18a: notyet -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
bool => error * -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
Utf8String => int | #invalid !! STR-types: notyet -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
(int, f64) => error * -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
int | #none => int | #none -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f64 | #none => int | #inexact | #invalid | #none -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=#none => error * !! CAST-atom-arg: #none -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
=2 => int -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=2.5 => error * -- sec:diagnostics "Decimal literal ... that nothing gives a carrier": the forms that fix the carrier ... a cast of an operand (half = f64(1) / 2)
=2.5f64 => error * -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=2r => int -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=k => int -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"

template: rat($0)
int => rat -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
rat => rat -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f32 => rat | #invalid -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f64 => rat | #invalid -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f16 => rat | #invalid !! L1.18a: notyet -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
bool => error * -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
Utf8String => rat | #invalid !! STR-types: notyet -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
(int, f64) => error * -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
int | #none => rat | #none -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
f64 | #none => rat | #invalid | #none -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=#none => error * !! CAST-atom-arg: #none -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
=2 => rat \ 0r -- L1.17 "rat(n) of an int n whose interval holds no 0 has a type without 0r"; sec:lexical "\ type difference"
=2.5 => rat !! CAST-fixes-literal: error Decimal literal, or `/` of integer literals, that nothing gives a carrier -- sec:diagnostics "Decimal literal ... that nothing gives a carrier": the forms that fix the carrier ... a cast of an operand (half = f64(1) / 2)
=2.5f64 => rat -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=2r => rat -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=k => rat \ 0r -- L1.17 "rat(n) of an int n whose interval holds no 0 has a type without 0r"; sec:lexical "\ type difference"

f64 | #none => f32 | #inexact | #none | #overflow -- sec:corner_cases "Casts are domain proofs"
=#none => error * !! CAST-atom-arg: #none -- sec:diagnostics "no cast from or to a type that has none, such as bool, an atom other than the #NaN and #inf"
